metadata.title: The Lorenz braid index and hyperbolic volume
metadata.abstract: A result of Futer, Kalfagianni, and Purcell implies that an upper volume bound for all link complements in the 3-sphere cannot depend solely on the braid index. In this paper, we introduce the Lorenz braid index and generalise the bunch algorithm to provide a general upper volume bound for all link complements in the 3-sphere. Such an upper bound is a quadratic polynomial in the Lorenz braid index. In addition, we construct an explicit family of hyperbolic Lorenz knots for which the classical braid index and the Seifert genus both tend to infinity, while the Lorenz braid index remains bounded.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 建立 Lorenz 链结体积关于 Lorenz 编织指数的一般二次上界，并构造区分不同复杂度指标的结族。
techniques: Lorenz 编织的 bunch 算法推广
analysis.breakthrough: 给出 Lorenz 指数有界而通常编织指数与亏格趋于无穷的例子。
analysis.limitations: 作者评论说明部分内容重组自早期预印本，需区分新增结论；Lorenz 指数不能等同通常编织指数。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。AI 披露另见独立核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。
